name: Settings
doc: Settings by hand: Theme (serves the active theme as CSS variables; a theme is a saved item of type theme, the most recently changed one is active), Features (the app's on/off switches) and Data (whether archived things may be deleted for good, off by default). Feature and data settings live in the kernel's settings item (/k/settings). Was the Theme plugin; /p/theme and /m/theme still work.

commands.name: default-theme
commands.doc: Make the default theme active again (saved as a new theme item)

modality.title: Settings
modality.doc: Theme, feature switches and data, set by hand
